assessment.assessment_title: RHEL 9 /etc/group file must be owned by root.
assessment.evidence_guidance: Retain the completed source OCIL evidence and reviewer notes.
assessment.procedure:
Manual alternative preserved from the original OCIL check. Follow the source procedure; this Assessment does not execute OCIL.

Verify the ownership of the "/etc/group" file with the following command:

$ sudo stat -c "%U %n" /etc/group 

root /etc/group 

If "/etc/group" file does not have an owner of "root", this is a finding.
